messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging on-call: elevated 5xx rate detected for tenant elysia on Dedicated cluster eu-west-2-pool-7. Alert rule: tenant_5xx_rate > 2% for 3m.
jen-oc: I'm on it — grabbing logs and routing table.
elysia-support: Thanks. We're seeing increased errors on our side around 12:02 UTC, dozens of failed requests per minute. Customers report timeouts in production.
soheil: Heads up — cluster metrics show inflight_request_queue length for elysia shot up from ~20 to ~120 per worker, CPU steal ~30%. GPU util still normal.
maria: Any recent deploys for elysia?
elysia-support: No deploys from us. We only run inference; they did kick off a big batch scoring job earlier this morning, could that be related?
ops-ryan: Can someone dump the per-tenant concurrency/queue config? I want to confirm if backpressure kicked in.
jen-oc: Pasting current config for pool-7 and tenant elysia:
```
# /etc/redwood/tenants/elysia.yaml
max_concurrency: "80"
max_inflight_queue: "100"
priority: "standard"
route_policy: "pool-7"
```
soheil: The queue growth suggests batch jobs are holding slots and causing head-of-line blocking. We have many long-running requests from elysia with large chunked payloads. KV cache pressure also high — eviction rate up 5x.
maria: Customer impact estimate?
elysia-support: Impacted customers: elysia prod namespace only. Approx 12% of requests returning 5xx/timeouts in last 10m, affecting ~1.2k requests/min. SLA threshold breached.
jen-oc: Mitigation proposal: 1) apply tenant-level temporary throttling at edge proxy to cap concurrency to 30 for elysia. 2) reroute small requests to fallback pool-2 where we have capacity. 3) evict long-running batch jobs if they exceed 3m since start. 4) increase KV cache capacity on pool-7 if possible.
ops-ryan: I can flip the proxy throttle and add reroute rule. Doing step 1 and 2 now.
deploy-bot: deploy started: proxy/tenant-throttle v3 -> target: pool-7 (rolling).
ops-ryan: throttle applied: elysia concurrency=30, rate limit=600r/m. Reroute rule created to send requests with header x-small=true to pool-2.
soheil: Nice. I'm kicking off a script to list current inflight requests and annotate long-running ones: `./scripts/list-inflight -p pool-7 --tenant elysia --min-duration 180s`
jen-oc: Results: 37 inflight, 9 > 3m, mostly large-batch RPCs from elysia-scoring-service.
soheil: I'm sending a kill to the top 3 longest requests (those are interactive control-plane allowed ops). Executing: `kill-inflight --id 98765 98766 98768`
ops-ryan: Confirmed kills accepted by runtime. Traffic dropped immediately. 5xx rate trending down from 12% -> 4% in 2m.
maria: Good progress. What's the KV eviction state?
soheil: KV evictions decreased after throttling but still elevated. We can bump pool-7 cache allocation by +20% as short term if infra OK.
ops-ryan: Requesting infra approval for cache bump: increased ephemeral disk for pool-7?
jen-oc: Infra team (cc @maria) can we increase cache? If not, we fallback to longer-term solution: pin a few hot models to pool-2 and warm caches there.
maria: I can approve +20% for 30 minutes. Applying now.
deploy-bot: infra change applied: pool-7 cache +20% (temp 30m).
soheil: With the throttle, reroutes, and kills, error rate is ~1.1% now and still declining. Latency P95 for elysia went from 1.8s to 1.1s.
elysia-support: Thank you. Customers are seeing improvements, but a subset still report sporadic timeouts for large scoring jobs.
jen-oc: Next steps for oncall handoff: we need a full postmortem, customer RCA, and quota change request for scoring jobs. I'm moving this to SEV-3 open until postmortem complete.
ops-ryan: I'll own the short-term config changes and add runbook entries for inflight queue spikes per tenant.
soheil: I'll investigate why batch scoring jobs are allowed to occupy unlimited concurrency — looks like a policy gap. Will propose a limit on batch job concurrency or dedicated batch lanes.
maria: I'll schedule a maintenance window if we need to move hot models off pool-7 for cache isolation.
elysia-support: We'll coordinate with Elysia SRE to throttle batch workflows and submit a ticket for long-term fixes.
jen-oc: Handing off to night oncall @maria in 45m. Please paste any follow-ups here.
maria: Acknowledged. I'll keep monitoring for next 2 hours and ensure error rates return to baseline.
incident-bot: Incident SEV-3 created: INC-2026-3509876543 — assigned: jen-oc, ops-ryan, soheil, maria.
jen-oc: Quick notes for postmortem: root cause likely batch scoring jobs causing inflight queue exhaustion + KV cache pressure leading to head-of-line 5xx and gateway timeouts. Temporary mitigations: proxy throttle, reroute to fallback pool, kill long requests, cache bump. Long-term: rate limits for batch jobs, per-tenant cache reservations, and a health signal to pre-emptively shed heavy batch lanes.
elysia-support: We'll collect customer logs and add timeline to incident doc. Thanks all. :heart:
jen-oc: Closing thread from active paging. Leave any residual items as comments in the incident doc.
